# PostPilot AI

> AI-powered SNS post generator specialized for Japanese business tone.

PostPilot AI generates optimized social media posts for Japanese businesses.
Select a platform (X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, note.com),
business scenario, and industry - AI generates 3 professional posts instantly.

## API

POST /api/generate
- Generate SNS posts with AI
- Parameters: platform, scenario, industry, tone, productName, details, targetAudience
- Returns: 3 optimized post patterns with character counts and hashtags

## Platforms
- twitter: X (Twitter) - 280 chars
- instagram: Instagram - 2200 chars
- linkedin: LinkedIn - 3000 chars
- facebook: Facebook - 63206 chars
- note: note - 100000 chars

## Scenarios
- new-product, campaign, recruitment, event, testimonial
- tips, industry-news, company-intro, achievement, announcement
- greeting, collaboration, seminar, media, daily

## Industries
- restaurant, retail, it, beauty, construction
- medical, education, real-estate, professional, manufacturing, other

## Tones
- formal, semi-casual, casual, friendly
